establishment.name: Santini's New York Style Deli - Chantilly

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COLESLAW AT 60F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 62F, HAM AT 57F, AND SLICED MEAT MIX AT 63F IN THE MIDDLE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP AT THE SERVICE LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED ALL TCS FOOD ITEMS TO ANOTHER COOLER/FREEZER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE SERVICE LINE 3-DOOR PREP TOP AT 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED TCS FOODS FROM COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE PREP TOP COOLERS ARE ONLY USED TO HOLD COLD FOODS (NOT COOLING).

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM OBSERVED ONSITE AT THE BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT A CFM SHOULD BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED TAKEKOUT BAGS (GROCERY BAGS) USED TO DIRECTLY STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent.PIC REMOVED FOODS FROM GROCERY BAGS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THEY ARE NOT FOOD-SAFE AND SHOULD NOT BE USED TO DIRECTLY STORE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the HANDWASHING SINK CLOSEST TO THE 3-DOOR UPR FREEZER is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC WILL ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK IS FIXED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SMALL GAP ALONG THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE ENSURE THE DOOR IS PROPERLY SEALED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO PREVENT PEST ENTRY.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DETACHED HOSE FROM FAUCET DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HOSE IS DETACHED AFTER USE OR INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.
